subject.title: [Feature]: Visible agent-to-agent messaging for ACP thread-bound sessions (proxy-only delivery without main session creation)

question: Which visible ACP-thread delivery contract should OpenClaw support for coordinator-originated instructions without creating main Discord session metadata?
rationale: The code can support several shapes, but choosing between sessions_send visibility, message proxy-only delivery, or an ACP-bound-thread exclusion changes public API semantics, sender authorization, bot-loop behavior, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add sessions_send visible mode
options.body: Add a narrow visible delivery mode to sessions_send for authorized ACP-bound targets, with proof that it posts visibly without recording a main Discord thread session.

options.title: Add proxy-only message send
options.body: Add an explicit message proxy-only path that bypasses outbound session recording only for authorized proxy sends while leaving ordinary message sends unchanged.

options.title: Decline core API change
options.body: Keep this as plugin/community orchestration work and document that core does not support visible coordinator-to-worker proxy sends without session metadata side effects.

recommendation.title: Add sessions_send visible mode
recommendation.body: Add a narrow visible delivery mode to sessions_send for authorized ACP-bound targets, with proof that it posts visibly without recording a main Discord thread session.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans sessions_send, gateway protocol, outbound metadata, and product/security boundaries where steipete is the strongest recent routing owner from current source and live path history.
